crs_note: British National Grid. Every raster and vector in the pipeline is held in this CRS; OSM arrives in WGS84 degrees and is reprojected by step 01.
origin_note: South-west corner of the tile grid, in CRS units. Whitby town centre is NZ893109 (E 489300, N 510900); the grid takes in the harbour, West Cliff, the East Cliff / abbey headland (E 490300, N 511200) and a row of sea to the north.
grid_res_note: Samples per tile edge. 513 = 512 + 1 so adjacent tiles share an identical edge row and there is no seam.
bbox_note: S,W,N,E -- Overpass order. Generous on purpose; features outside the tile grid are counted and dropped by steps 06/07/10.
vertical_datum_note: Ordnance Datum Newlyn -- the datum of the EA LIDAR. Every elevation the pipeline emits, including water_level, is metres above this.
water_level_note: PROVISIONAL. Whitby's tidal range is ~5 m and the survey's tide state is unknown until the DTM is on disk. After step 03, read the flat sea-surface value off dtm.vrt north of the piers and set this to it.

height_calib.note: mode auto: step 07 regresses height = intercept + m_per_level * building:levels from this site's own buildings that carry both a levels tag and a trustworthy LIDAR p50, records the fit in massing_manifest.json, and uses it. The fallback is Margate's line and is NOT a measurement of Whitby -- if the manifest says it was used, Whitby has too few tagged buildings and the fit needs seeding by hand.

coast.note: PROVISIONAL, to be checked against the first DTM. foreshore_max_odn: Whitby has sandy beaches under West Cliff and a rocky scar under East Cliff; set it just above the surveyed high-water sand so the beach reads as sand without painting the harbour quays. rock_slope_deg: the cliffs here are shale and boulder clay -- slumped and stepped, not a single chalk face -- so the ramp starts a little later than Margate's.

landmarks._note: None yet, deliberately. Hand overrides are for buildings the LIDAR p50 estimator provably gets wrong -- add them after reading qa_height_outliers.json from the first run, not before. Candidates: Whitby Abbey (roofless ruin -- p50 samples the floor between the walls) and St Mary's church tower.
